entities.name: CHCHD10
observations: CHCHD10 c.197G>T (p.Gly66Val) is reported as causing autosomal-dominant spinal muscular atrophy Jokela type (SMAJ), a late-onset spinal motor neuronopathy phenotype. PMID:38020590; original segregation details not independently verified in this search.

entities.name: SMAJ (Jokela type)
observations: Autosomal-dominant late-onset spinal motor neuronopathy associated with CHCHD10 p.Gly66Val; distinct from infantile SMARD1. PMID:38020590.
